title: Control Plane Tactical Roundup — June 2, 2026
content:
Attendance: Maya (owner), Aisha, Connor, Diego, Priya, Omar. Casual drop-ins: Lucas Bell for the quota discussion.

Context / purpose: Quick tactical roundup focusing on three overlaps we've seen in the last week: (1) a small control-plane steady-state regression impacting long-tail request throttles, (2) two routing edge-cases where traffic skew exposed quota accounting bugs, and (3) an upcoming auth token rotation window for Private deployments. This doc is a shorthand for the meeting, decisions, and concrete next steps.

Agenda:
- Quick status (2m)
- Control plane regression status and rollback options (10m)
- Routing + quota anomalies, mitigation, and monitoring tweaks (12m)
- Auth/keys: rotation plan + customer comms (8m)
- Action items and owners (5m)

Highlights / decisions made in meeting:
- We will not revert the last runtime control-plane change immediately; instead we’ll deploy a targeted hotfix to fix the token leak in the request broker that appears to surface as elevated throttle counts for long-poll sessions. Decision rationale: risk to ongoing work from full revert > benefit; hotfix impacts smaller surface area.
- Quota accounting: temporarily enable conservative quota enforcement flag in prod for routing namespace "shared-burst" to prevent overshoot while we patch the aggregation window logic. Flag will be toggled at 09:00 UTC 2026-06-03 and monitored for 6h.
- Auth rotation: start rolling rotation for Private deployments on 2026-06-10. Customers will receive a heads-up on 2026-06-04 via the usual private-deployments-cust channel. We will provide a one-click token-update script in the repo linked in the customer note.

Incidents / recent anomalies (summary):
- Symptom: Intermittent spikes in "throttled_long_poll_requests" metric, customers reporting increased latency for streaming responses after 2026-05-28 deploy.
- Short RCA notes: root cause appears to be a race in the control-plane request broker where stale session handles were not getting evicted fast enough, causing a backlog that interacts poorly with the new continuous-batching scheduler. The backlog triggers quota window miscounts and then conservative throttling.
- Evidence: heap snapshots and broker logs (CONFLUENCE-PLAT-1186) show 2x increase in open session handles on affected replicas. Related PR: serving-runtime#3421 added an optimization that changed eviction timing.

Routing & Quotas (detailed):
- Observed: Two routing edge cases where route affinity combined with region-fallback produced duplicate accounting records for a request re-route. These appear when requests are re-routed within the same 30s aggregation window.
- Impact: Small number of customers saw quota consumption rise ~1.4x for a 12h window. Not billing-critical but alarming.
- Temporary mitigations:
  - Enable conservative enforcement flag for "shared-burst" namespace (owner: Connor Li, toggle scheduled 2026-06-03 09:00 UTC).
  - Increase quota-aggregation window from 30s to 45s for routes with re-route enabled (monitor impact for 24h).
- Longer-term fix: Update routing accounting to dedupe request ids at aggregation step; scoped PR target: serving-runtime, follow-up ticket JIRA-PLAT-1004 (owner: Diego, due 2026-06-09).
- Monitoring changes: Add a new alert "quota-routing-dup-delta" that fires at 10% sustained difference between route-increment and billing-increment over 10m (owner: Aisha, ETA 2026-06-04).

Auth / Keys / Private deployments:
- Reminder: Key rotation for private control plane scheduled 2026-06-10. Plan details: staged rotation by customer batch of ~10 clusters per 3h window, automated rollback hook if auth failures >0.5% for 30m.
- Action: Create customer-facing runbook (owner: Priya Nair, due 2026-06-04) with exact commands, troubleshooting steps, and link to the one-click script in the private-deployments repo.
- Note: HSM/KMS integration test uncovered a minor IAM permissions gap when the rotation script runs under the CI runner role; ticket opened: JIRA-PLAT-1012 (owner: Omar, due 2026-06-05).

Operational notes / telemetry:
- Dashboard changes: Add token-leak heatmap to control-plane dashboards; high-cardinality dimension = replica-id, bucketed by 5m. (Owner: Aisha, small dashboard PR planned 2026-06-03).
- Tracing: Add a sampling rule for long-poll paths to increase trace capture rate from 0.1% to 5% for next 48h starting 2026-06-03 (Owner: Connor).

Action items (concrete):
- Connor Li: Toggle conservative quota enforcement flag for "shared-burst" at 09:00 UTC 2026-06-03 and verify quota consumption curves for next 6h. Status: scheduled.
- Diego Ramirez: PR for dedupe-at-aggregation in routing accounting; branch + tests by 2026-06-07, PR by 2026-06-09. Status: in progress.
- Priya Nair: Draft and publish customer runbook + email for private deployment key rotation by 2026-06-04. Status: assigned.
- Omar Haddad: Fix IAM gap for rotation CI runner (JIRA-PLAT-1012), test with dummy rotation in staging by 2026-06-05. Status: assigned.
- Aisha Patel: Dashboard + alert changes (quota-routing-dup-delta) live by 2026-06-04. Status: in progress.
- Maya Chen (me): Coordinate post-mortem doc skeleton and assign owners for RCA write-up; initial draft by 2026-06-05.

Risks / Blockers: 
- If the hotfix to the broker eviction logic is delayed >72h we risk seeing continued throttle noise during peak traffic windows (approx windows 14:00-18:00 UTC).
- Customer concerns: A small set of Private deploy customers have expressed nervousness about token rotation timing; if communications slip, churn risk increases.
- Infra capacity: Running expanded tracing at 5% for long-poll paths will double trace storage for those routes; SRE budget sign-off required for >48h.

Unresolved questions:
- Do we want to keep the aggregation window change permanent? Need A/B with more traffic shapes before committing.
- Should we expose the conservative quota enforcement flag as a service-level toggle per-tenant? Ops prefers a central flag for quick mitigation but product wants finer control. Product input needed.

Backlog / follow-ups:
- Post-mortem publish (doc + runbook) + customer incident letter if RCA indicates customer-visible root cause (owner: Maya, target 2026-06-09).
- Routing accounting end-to-end load test in staging with re-route enabled (owner: Diego, ETA 2026-06-08).
- Policy discussion on per-tenant mitigation flags (owner: Priya to loop in Product and Sales for decision by 2026-06-11).

Notes to self / meeting artifacts:
- Slack thread: https://slack-redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567/p1622534400000500
- Logs: s3://redwood-logs/platform/2026-05-28/broker-heap-snapshots/*
- Quick perf experiment: rollback the continuous-batching scheduler change in a canary 1/8 pool to validate hypothesis (low-risk toggle; owner: Connor, try window 2026-06-04 02:00-06:00 UTC).

Next check-in: Short sync Wednesday 2026-06-03 09:30 UTC to confirm metrics after quota flag toggle and to decide on immediate hotfix timeline. Full standup as usual Friday 2026-06-04.

Raw notes / brain-dump (unstructured):
- "If dedupe is done at collection time rather than aggregation time we avoid locking expensive route maps, but memory pressure could spike" — flagged as architectural tradeoff.
- "Customers on Private with on-prem HSMs: coordinate with infra-onprem team for local test harness" — Priya to set meeting.
- "Consider exposing a 'safe-mode' API that makes quota enforcement no-op for a tenant for X minutes with audit trail" — idea capture; product conversation needed.

End of notes.
